title: Silver Supply Deficit: 76.2 Million Ounces Short
narration: This chart illustrates the growing silver supply deficit, projected to reach over 100 million ounces by 2026.  Driven by reduced mine production, rising production costs, and slowed new discoveries – with a significant drop in new silver discoveries of 75% over the last decade – this deficit is fueling upward pressure on silver prices.  The gap between supply and demand is widening, presenting investors with an opportunity to strategically position themselves.
